1. Services
TRUE CARE provides a platform connecting patients with caregivers. We facilitate service listing and payments.

2. Payment Terms
Patients agree to pay the total session cost as billed. Partial payments are accepted but balance must be cleared before the next session. Refunds are subject to our refund policy.

3. Caregiver Responsibility
Caregivers are responsible for providing professional care during assigned shifts. Clock-in/out times must be accurate.

4. Liability
TRUE CARE acts as an intermediary. We are not liable for actions taken during a shift but provide mediation and verification.

5. Governing Law
These terms are governed by the laws of Kenya. Disputes will be handled in Kenyan courts.
